text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can make unfair decisions if they are trained on poor data. Fairness means that AI should treat all people equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is also crucial, since AI often collects and uses personal information. People need to know how their data is used. Transparency helps users understand how AI makes decisions, which builds trust. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect everyone and ensure technology benefits society.
